title: Temporary addresses lie in scratch space
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $F$, every temporary address indexed from $k$ through $2F$, together with the address $c_{\mathrm{ADDR}}$, belongs to the scratch set consisting of the four designated scratch addresses and all temporary addresses indexed from $0$ through $2F$.
